statement.p: An individual is being prompted to create a/an 7 digit PIN (personal identification number) to add security to their account on a website. Each of the digits must be number from 0 - 9.

ol.li: If digits may be repeated as many times as the user likes, then there are Preview Question 1 Part 1 of 3 PINs possible.
If no two consecutive digits may be the same, then there are Preview Question 1 Part 2 of 3 PINs possible.
If no digit may be repeated, then there are Preview Question 1 Part 3 of 3 PINs possible.
